title: State of Updated Configuration
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $x$ be a finite bit string, and let $\Lambda$ be a type. Given any configuration $c$ for input $x$ with $m$ work tapes, any state $s\in\Lambda$, any valid input-head position $ip$, any work-tape index $r<m$, and any integer position $p$, the state of the updated configuration is $s$.
